name: dot-panel
description: An AGPL framework and agent skills for creating and maintaining your own private, customizable Dot Panel in ChatGPT Sites.

interface.longDescription: Create and personalize your own private touch dashboard with agent-guided setup and maintenance. Dot Panel includes a Needs You queue for ordinary yes/no and multiple-choice questions, Dismiss and Later controls, project and calendar snapshots, themes, saved layouts and widget authoring skills. Requires supported ChatGPT Sites tools and a user-connected Site plugin; installing this framework does not provision or connect a panel automatically. Feeds use your authorized integrations and show snapshot freshness. Optional automatic Codex usage snapshots require a compatible existing local Codex CLI connection and an owner-launched Python helper; no always-on ChatGPT process or reboot autostart is included. Panel choices cannot bypass platform approval requirements. This release candidate has automated checks and a synthetic current-owner private installation proof, but independent-user, iPad/VoiceOver and public-directory installation have not been verified.
defaultPrompt: Set up my private Dot Panel with the modules I choose
Customize a widget while preserving my saved layouts
Set up optional local usage tracking for my own panel
